# dataiku_project (Resource)

A Dataiku DSS project.

Deleting this resource permanently deletes the project on the instance. Use the `clear_*_on_delete` arguments to control what data DSS removes along with it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "dataiku_project" "analytics" {
  project_key = "ANALYTICS"
  name        = "Analytics"
  owner       = "admin"

  short_desc  = "Shared analytics workspace"
  description = "Datasets and recipes backing the weekly revenue report."

  tags = ["managed-by-terraform", "analytics"]
}

# Deleting a project is destructive. These arguments control how much DSS
# clears along with it; all default to keeping data except the logs.
resource "dataiku_project" "scratch" {
  project_key = "SCRATCH"
  name        = "Scratch"
  owner       = "admin"

  clear_managed_datasets_on_delete       = true
  clear_output_managed_folders_on_delete = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Display name of the project.
- `owner` (String) Login of the DSS user who owns the project.
- `project_key` (String) Unique identifier of the project on the instance. Letters, digits and underscores only. Changing this forces a new project.

### Optional

- `clear_job_and_scenario_logs_on_delete` (Boolean) Whether to clear job and scenario logs when the project is deleted.
- `clear_managed_datasets_on_delete` (Boolean) Whether to clear the data of managed datasets when the project is deleted.
- `clear_output_managed_folders_on_delete` (Boolean) Whether to clear the data of managed folders used as recipe outputs when the project is deleted.
- `description` (String) Long description of the project, shown on the project home page.
- `project_folder_id` (String) ID of the project folder to create the project in. Defaults to the root folder. DSS does not report a project's folder through the public API, so this value is only applied at creation and is not refreshed. Changing it forces a new project.
- `short_desc` (String) Short description of the project, shown on the project tile.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags applied to the project.

A set, not a list: DSS stores tags unordered and hands them back in its own order, so the order written here is not preserved and duplicates collapse.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The project key. Same value as `project_key`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Projects are imported by their project key.
terraform import dataiku_project.analytics ANALYTICS
```
